blocks.text: A RevOps stack that doesn't leak deals between systems.
Clean CRM data, automatic lead routing, accurate attribution, and forecasts your CRO actually trusts. We build the plumbing so sales, marketing, and CS work off the same numbers.

Pipeline visibility your CRO will actually trust

Most RevOps teams forecast off CRM data they know is stale. We close the loop between activity capture, opportunity stage, and reporting so the numbers in the board deck match the numbers in Salesforce.
Signal-based pipeline
Stage changes driven by real engagement, not rep optimism.
One source of truth
MQL through closed-won in one dashboard, not five exports.
Lead routing and CRM hygiene, without the cleanup project
Round-robin breaks when reps are out. Territory rules drift. Duplicate accounts pile up. We rebuild routing as code and run dedupe in the background so SDRs work fresh leads, not yesterday's.
Routing logic that holds under load
Territory, segment, ICP fit, and capacity all factored in. MQL to SAL handoff happens in minutes, with the right owner and the right context.
Hygiene that runs while you sleep
Dedupe, enrichment, account hierarchy, stale opp cleanup. Activity capture writes back from Gmail, calendar, and Gong so reps stop logging calls by hand.
Attribution marketing will defend and finance will accept

Multi-touch attribution falls apart the moment someone questions the weighting. We build the model in the open, expose every touchpoint, and reconcile pipeline sourced vs influenced so the argument ends.
Closed-loop attribution
Every touch from first ad to closed-won, tied to opportunity and ARR.
Funnel diagnostics
Stage-by-stage conversion and time-in-stage so you see where deals stall.
CAC and NRR in one view
Acquisition cost by segment beside retention so spend follows the LTV.
Forecasts you can commit to, handoffs that don't drop

Forecast accuracy improves when the model sees what reps see. We pull engagement, deal age, stage velocity, and rep commit confidence into one view, and route sales-to-CS handoffs with the context that keeps onboarding clean.
AI-assisted forecast roll-ups
Rep commits, manager calls, and signal-based predictions side by side. Variance flagged before the QBR, not after.
Sales to CS handoff, automated
Closed-won triggers an onboarding playbook with full deal context, success criteria, and the right CSM assigned by segment.
Deal desk: approvals, discounting, and quote generation routed without Slack chasing.
Territory changes: reassignments propagate to ownership, comp, and reporting in one move.
Churn signals: CS gets pinged when usage or sentiment slips, before renewal is on the line.
